builds.name: Reference: Crit spell weave
builds.goal: Reference for Corki: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged AD spell-and-attack hybrid who uses resistance shred and missiles while weaving attacks to refill R charges. His current passive adds true damage rather than converting his attacks to magic. Compare missile/spell cycling with real attacks refilling R charges. The current passive adds true damage; do not apply an old magic-conversion assumption to attacks. Crit and attacks between compatible spells test cooldown recycling and mana-supported trading.
builds.summary: Crit and attacks between compatible spells test cooldown recycling and mana-supported trading.
testPlan: Kit question for Corki: Compare missile/spell cycling with real attacks refilling R charges. The current passive adds true damage; do not apply an old magic-conversion assumption to attacks.

Start with the early core (Essence Reaver, then crit according to the interaction) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and attacks between compatible spells test cooldown recycling and mana-supported trading. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Navori requires real attacks and compatible cooldowns; do not grant its benefit to every cast.

The route fails Corki's stated kit question: Compare missile/spell cycling with real attacks refilling R charges. The current passive adds true damage; do not apply an old magic-conversion assumption to attacks.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Navori requires real attacks and compatible cooldowns; do not grant its benefit to every cast.
Full cost 17,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Essence Reaver, then crit according to the interaction. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Navori Flickerblade, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
